items.title: Jon Weber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 2, 2012
items.q: I think it was The Artist’s Corner in Minneapolis and you probably saw it on YouTube maybe? Alex Hahn on alto sax?

ctx.x: Yeah really. I knew you were going to say that, or I thought you would. “Really?” Like it almost was so subtly done, but I’m pretty sure it was, but I remember at the moment listening to it. I wonder if you knew that you did that or if it was just so — it was a half a quote almost.
I think I remember the venue. I think it was The Artist’s Corner in Minneapolis and you probably saw it on YouTube maybe? Alex Hahn on alto sax?
